title: Claude, please make me Grand Theft Auto but in 18th century France
author: Galitzianer0
selftext:
Working Title:  Reign of Terror.  Instead of doing jobs for gangs like in GTA, you pick a particular factions to support in the French Revolution and ultimately decide the fate of what 18th century France becomes:  
  
White = The Bourbons, Absolute Monarchists, defenders of the Ancien Regime  
Purple = The Nobility, Aristocratic Privileges, Feudal Rights  
Gold = The Clergy, ecclesiastical authority  
Blue = The Feuillants, The Constitutional Monarchists, 1791 constitution  
Green = The Girondins, Moderate/ Republican Revolutionaries  
Red = Jacobins / Montagnards, Radical Republican Revolutionaries  
Black = Sans-culottes / Enrages, Urban Populism, Militant Egalitarianism &Proto-Socialist  


These factions shift and have opinions of one another and thus if you become a well known Monarchist you may find yourself at an uneasy alliance with the Nobility and then open hostility as the game progresses and so forth, you can also run missions that will improve relations with your faction and other ones.   

The guns are all flintlock so you won't be gunning anyone down with an uzi, it takes time to reload and very different strategizing than modern warfare, and melee weapons can be very effective still.

And if any of you have ideas I'd love to hear them!

comments.author: DrPaisa
comments.body: Looks great what is the workload for the buildings?  I assume its three.js?

replies.author: Galitzianer0
replies.body:
Godot 4.4, Forward+ renderer.  There's no workload for the buildings in fact, nothing is modelled, there's no blender file, no imported mesh, no artist-authored building anywhere in the project.  Every facade, roof, chimney and monument is generated from code at runtime from a seed.

There's 5,076 lots, 2,014 street segments, 376 blocks -- the layout and the river Seine, the district zoning and the lot subdivision are all procedural, there's 7,800 pedestrians in the city with 500 simulated at any given time.
